title: Sidebar
api:
interface SidebarItem {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: ReactNode
  badge?: string | number
  disabled?: boolean
}

interface SidebarProps {
  title: string
  items: SidebarItem[]
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void
  collapsed?: boolean
  defaultCollapsed?: boolean
  onCollapsedChange?: (collapsed: boolean) => void
  mobileOpen?: boolean
  onMobileOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  footer?: ReactNode
  disabled?: boolean
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  className?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
}

function Sidebar({
  title,
  items,
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  collapsed,
  defaultCollapsed = false,
  onCollapsedChange,
  mobileOpen,
  onMobileOpenChange,
  footer,
  disabled,
  size = 'md',
  className,
  'aria-label': label,
}: SidebarProps);
